activate_configuration.prompt_note: add_configuration does NOT switch the variant in — call this after tailoring it; confirm the switch via the returned body count/volume.

add_configuration.prompt_note: Creates the variant but never activates it — follow with set_config_override / set_config_suppression, then activate_configuration.

add_datum.prompt_note: Read feature/label points from review_drawing first (sheet mm); declare datums before any add_gdt frame that references them.

add_detail_view.prompt_note: cx,cy,radius are the PARENT view's sheet mm — read them from review_drawing; for a cut through the whole part use add_section_view.

add_dimension.prompt_note: For whole-view auto-dimensioning prefer make_drawing's model_items; use this for one-offs, snapping a,b to vertices read from review_drawing.

add_drawing_view.prompt_note: One view per call on an existing drawing_doc_id (from make_drawing); the first/anchor view should be view_type='base', x,y are sheet mm.

add_features.prompt_note: Batch related ops in ONE call and read `interpreted` + per-feature status; a heavy op may return {job_id} — poll get_job. Verify with render_part.

add_gdt.prompt_note: Place from review_drawing sheet-mm coordinates; declare referenced datums with add_datum first, diameter=True adds the ⌀ zone.

add_section_view.prompt_note: Cuts the parent view through its centre only — no sheet math needed; a magnified local region is add_detail_view instead.

add_surface_finish.prompt_note: a/pos are sheet mm from review_drawing; ra is a string ("1.6"). One symbol per call — review_drawing again to check placement.

adopt_role.prompt_note: Main session only — supervised subagents must request a role change via the advisor instead.

advise.prompt_note: Match stage to your workflow phase — the default 'assembly' only runs interference; pass run_id to log for dispute/replay.

advisory_dispute.prompt_note: Contest only with concrete evidence; kernel-sourced disputes return waiver_required=true — a human must confirm the waiver.

analyze_stl_geometry.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health. Takes doc_id, not a file path — import_part the mesh first, then call this on the document.

apply_ascii_edits.prompt_note: Preview with dry_run=True; pass grid_json + index_json from the last render_*_ascii reply so cell coords resolve against that raster, not a re-render.

ask_user.prompt_note: No-human path: each question is answered with its `suggested` default (source:'default'), never fabricated; pass run_id so gates replay.

asm_add_component.prompt_note: Places a FILE — save_part each part first; the FIRST component is fixed by default. Returns the 'k<N>' id that asm_mate refs use.

asm_mate.prompt_note: Standard seat: concentric (shank↔bore) + coincident (head↔plate); each query must resolve to ONE face/edge — narrow with pick/near/count.

assembly_plan_review.prompt_note: Run at PLANNING time, before a large build — it advises subassembly grouping; deep products should be mated subassemblies, not one giant file.

assess_mesh_quality.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health. We are a B-rep kernel, so this reports SOLID topology health, not triangle quality.

bearing_life.prompt_note: Standalone hand-calc — no document needed. Set X/Y when Fa matters (defaults zero the axial term); C must come from a datasheet.

board_from_schematic.prompt_note: One-call layout on the active wired schematic — pass ERC first; read residual_drc honestly, then ecad_run_dfm / ecad_run_pdn.

bom_price.prompt_note: Network-bound per bought line and useless without provider credentials (Nexar/Digi-Key/Mouser) — unpriced lines come back price-unknown, never guessed. Run bom_rollup first.

bom_rollup.prompt_note: Cheap local classification pass — run it before any pricing: made lines go to cam_cost_estimate, bought lines (with MPNs) to bom_price.

box_status.prompt_note: Box.com mirror health: enabled/connected, the connected account, pending spooled projects, and the project's last sync/error. Call before box_sync to diagnose auth or backlog.

box_sync.prompt_note: Uploads the project's saved files to the configured Box.com folder NOW (new/changed only, never downloads). Saves already mirror automatically when Box is enabled — reach for this only when the user asks to push or box_status shows pending/errors.

buildgraph_plan.prompt_note: Prefer this over dag_plan when the build steps are already known — deterministic, LLM-free; check advisories + interpreted first.

buildgraph_status.prompt_note: Poll with the run_id from buildgraph_plan; an unknown id returns known_run_ids — pick from that list, never invent one.

cad_graph.prompt_note: blast before editing a shared dimension (what breaks downstream), tree for assembly structure; project_dir is the shared working folder.

cad_graph_link.prompt_note: Record a relationship the extractor can't see (e.g. two parts sharing a bore diameter); persisted as origin='ai' in the project overlay.

cad_guide.prompt_note: Call FIRST in any modeling session — 'overview' for the op cheatsheet, a feature name ('hole', 'sweep') for its exact param shape.

cam_add_operation.prompt_note: Get geometry from cam_extract first; omit rpm/feed in params to auto-resolve from material+tool. Call cam_generate after adding ops.

cam_add_setup.prompt_note: Needs an active job — cam_new_job first. Stock defaults to a bbox box-offset; pass cam_extract(kind='stock') output for tighter stock.

cam_add_tool.prompt_note: Define tools before ops — cam_add_operation references them by tool_number, and reusing a number replaces. cam_tool_types lists valid types.

cam_audit.prompt_note: Deterministic G-code verify — run after cam_post before shipping; ok=false means errors, but review warnings too. Works job-free via gcode=.

cam_check_feeds_envelope.prompt_note: Range-checks caller-pinned rpm/feed/stepdown against the table envelope; use feeds_speeds when you want the envelope itself.

cam_cost_estimate.prompt_note: Runs cam_simulate internally for cycle time — the doc just needs CAM ops, not a pre-run sim. Unknown material returns ok=false; pass material= to override.

cam_extract.prompt_note: Reads the CURRENT part (build/open one first) unless path= is given. kind='holes' feeds drill geometry, 'stock' feeds cam_add_setup.

cam_generate.prompt_note: Run after all ops are added, before cam_simulate/cam_post — its warnings (e.g. tool too large for a pocket) beat simulation failures.

cam_job_diff.prompt_note: Run before cam_save to review what changed since the last save, or to sanity-check a hand-edited .cam+ against the live job.

cam_job_tree.prompt_note: Cheap state read — use it to recover setup_id / op_id / tool numbers after context loss instead of re-creating the job.

cam_materials.prompt_note: Valid material ids for cam_add_setup and feeds_speeds; the CuttingDB group ids are what the feeds/speeds priors key on.

cam_new_job.prompt_note: Entry point of every CAM workflow — call first; all siblings act on the job it makes current. Then cam_add_tool/setup/op.

cam_op_types.prompt_note: Valid type strings for cam_add_operation; the op type decides which geometry key (regions/contours/points/profile/mesh) it needs.

cam_open.prompt_note: Replaces the active job — cam_save any unsaved work first.

cam_post.prompt_note: Final step once cam_simulate is clean; verify the output with cam_audit before shipping it to a machine.

cam_post_dialects.prompt_note: Static list — one call suffices. Pick the dialect at cam_new_job(post=...) or override it at cam_post.

cam_redo.prompt_note: Re-applies the last undone edit — only meaningful right after cam_undo.

cam_remove_operation.prompt_note: Undoable via cam_undo. Check cam_job_tree for current op_ids before removing.

cam_save.prompt_note: Persists the job tree (not G-code) to .cam+; reopen with cam_open, review changes later with cam_job_diff.

cam_set_stock.prompt_note: from_sim chains setups: cam_simulate setup 1, then reuse its remaining stock as setup 2's stock for a flip/second-side op.

cam_setup_sheet.prompt_note: Operator-facing summary for the machine floor — needs generated toolpaths (cam_generate first) for cut lengths and times.

cam_simulate.prompt_note: Needs generated toolpaths — cam_generate first. Smaller resolution = finer/slower; check_holder only flags when holder geometry is defined.

cam_tool_import.prompt_note: Needs an active CAM job (cam_new_job first); ops reference the returned tool_number. Feeds/speeds come from feeds_speeds(), not the part record.

cam_tool_types.prompt_note: Valid type strings for cam_add_tool, each with the cutting-data class that feeds/speeds auto-resolution uses.

cam_undo.prompt_note: Reverts the last job edit (ops, tools, setups, stock) — not toolpath generation. Prefer cam_update_operation to fix a bad param.

cam_update_operation.prompt_note: Merge-patch — only the keys you pass change. Edits do not regenerate toolpaths; call cam_generate afterwards.

channel_send.prompt_note: Cross-department channel post (org layer must be active); interface_change auto-acks and blocks your stage exit until acked — keep the body under 120 words.

check_feature_overlap.prompt_note: add_features already runs this per batch (overlap_warnings) — call to re-scan the whole tree or a features=[...] subset; bodies → check_interference.

check_geometry_health.prompt_note: Is this solid actually sound? Reports watertight/manifold plus the COUNTS AND SIDS that justify it (free edges, non-manifold edges, shells, solids, sliver faces, orientation). Run it before an expensive FEA mesh, a CAM toolpath or a STEP/STL export. `self_intersection` is always checked:false — the kernel has no single-body test; use check_interference instead. `volume_mm3` is null for a body with no solid. repair/fill_holes/fix_normals/fix_winding are REFUSED: fix the feature that made the bad body, using the sids it just listed.

check_interference.prompt_note: Needs 2+ bodies — solve_mates first on an assembly so placements are real; overlap INSIDE one part's features → check_feature_overlap.

check_metadata.prompt_note: Read this before verify_battery to pick check names and see cost/platform classes — it is the registry of everything the battery can run.

check_sketch.prompt_note: Require dof 0 before extruding/sweeping; 'under' lists what's loose, 'over' means drop a conflicting/redundant constraint — then re-check.

check_sketch3d.prompt_note: sketch3d twin of check_sketch; a sweep-spine path needn't reach dof 0, but pinned paths survive edits. wires[k] maps to the sweep ref.

check_symmetry.prompt_note: Confirms an intended mirror really is symmetric (deviation_mm3); spell the plane as axis pair ('XY') or normal ('+z') — Z-up datums.

close_part.prompt_note: save_part deliverables BEFORE closing — unsaved AI-owned docs return unsaved_changes and stay open; discard=True is for scratch only.

code_check.prompt_note: doc_path must be an aicad.structure/1 JSON doc; post_size/connection_type run standalone without it. Preliminary check — not sealed engineering.

compare_parts.prompt_note: Re-prove any manual rebuild/edit against the reference (doc_a). No alignment is done — a moved copy scores low; degraded:true means the boolean itself failed.

confirm_dimensions.prompt_note: The only way to close fit-critical demands: typed caliper values, not photo reads. Pass run_id so DAG gates never re-ask.

contact_sheet.prompt_note: Fast multi-angle self-check after a mutation; full manufacturing 6-ortho+iso grid → render_views, one feature's close-up → inspect_part.

convert_face_to_sketch.prompt_note: Creates a NEW sketch on one planar face; to trace into an open sketch use project_into_sketch. Get face sids from describe_part, then extrude/cut/revolve the regions.

council_convene.prompt_note: Convenes a 2-round multi-seat deliberation (build_strategy, spec_review, failure_review, …); stage/tier default from mission context — slow, reserve for genuinely contested calls.

dag_abort.prompt_note: Cancels a gate-paused run (decision=reject); omit run_id to hit this session's latest run. autonomy_default must match dag_run.

dag_approve.prompt_note: The continue-button after dag_run returns interrupted — resumes execution to the next gate; autonomy_default must match dag_run.

dag_plan.prompt_note: LLM planner — verify the returned graph before dag_run; for a known mechanical sequence prefer deterministic buildgraph_plan instead.

dag_replan.prompt_note: Mid-run surgery: spliced nodes need end_condition + a back-edge with retry_budget or validation fails; route via replan_request first.

dag_run.prompt_note: Plan with dag_plan or mission_start first, then omit graph_json to reuse that plan; run_id with no checkpoint yet STARTS a run under that id; interrupted → paused at a gate: dag_approve/dag_abort.

dag_status.prompt_note: Restart-safe topology; gate_pending is TRI-STATE — null means this process never ran it, not that no gate is pending. Use mission_status for the phase narrative.

delegate.prompt_note: The brief must be fully self-contained — the child sees no chat history. Give role + concrete task + acceptance criteria.

describe_assembly.prompt_note: Run solve_mates first — placements and gaps are narrated as stored, so stale mate state means stale numbers. For a single solid part use describe_part.

describe_board.prompt_note: Needs an open ECAD doc (ecad_new_schematic / ecad_new_pcb) first; narrates stored ERC/DRC numbers only — it never re-runs the checks.

describe_part.prompt_note: Make this the first read on any part — the returned sids (faces AND edges) are the stable addresses every later hover() / query_geometry / edit call uses. Call it before naming geometry you have not confirmed exists.

describe_project.prompt_note: Pass dag_status()['run'] for live status; a bare brief string is only narrated back — describe_project reports runs, dag_plan creates them.

describe_results.prompt_note: Run a study first (run_fea_static / run_fea_modal / run_cfd_flow) — it narrates persisted results only and never recomputes.

describe_reveng_result.prompt_note: Read `state`, not just match_pct: built+scored=false means the compare degraded, not a zero fit; state=running means poll again later.

describe_scene.prompt_note: Occlusion is not modeled — a hidden face still lists if it faces the camera; confirm true visibility with render_part when vision is available.

describe_sketch.prompt_note: Takes the sketch feature id ('s1'); once the shape is known, check_sketch returns the same DOF verdict in a much smaller payload.

describe_toolpaths.prompt_note: Needs an active CAM job with results — cam_generate + cam_simulate first; audit=False skips the cam_audit summary for a shorter read.

design_audit.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health — solid soundness only. It does NOT check DFM, tolerances or drawings; those are dfm_check, stackup_analyze and review_drawing.

design_recipe.prompt_note: Empty query lists the recipe catalog; a natural-language query returns ordered steps with params and verify hints.

design_review.prompt_note: One-call narrated battery (interference→dfm→layout_coverage); scope with checks=[...]. Machine-readable {scores,findings} twin → verify_battery.

dfm_check.prompt_note: Run before export; uses the process bound by set_process unless you pass process=. Returns a pass/fail list with the offending values.

doc_diff_tool.prompt_note: Both args are full-document JSON STRINGS (e.g. get_part output), not doc_ids; µm-level float noise is suppressed so unchanged rebuilds diff empty.

doc_sketch_contact_sheet.prompt_note: One image of the doc PLUS every in-progress sketch's health — the pre-commit check that catches under-defined sketches before an extrude fails.

draft_analysis.prompt_note: Mold-release check along pull_dir — the SIGN matters (-Z ≠ +Z); flagged faces come back with centroid+area so you know where to add draft.

ecad_add_power.prompt_note: Drop on a pin's world xy (from ecad_place_symbol's pin list) to bond it to the rail wire-free; undriven-power ERC clears only via a port.

ecad_add_zone.prompt_note: Common case: net='GND' with no geometry floods the board outline. The pour is preview-only until ecad_fill_zones — fill before export/DRC.

ecad_airflow_handoff.prompt_note: Minutes-long OpenFOAM CHT — only when convection presets look wrong (enclosure/fan). dry_run=True inspects the case; verify after with ecad_verify_airflow.

ecad_antenna_analyze.prompt_note: Always returns a closed-form resonance estimate. want_fullwave=True additionally uses openEMS only when installed; otherwise fullwave.skipped is evidence of no full-wave result, not PASS. Frequencies are Hz. Refine n_freq/max_timesteps and check the full-wave block before trusting S11.

ecad_antenna_design.prompt_note: Design first, then validate via ecad_antenna_analyze with the same params. meander_turns only affects ifa/pifa, velocity_factor only monopole; include_geometry=False returns dims only.

ecad_autoplace.prompt_note: Run after ecad_update_from_sch and before routing; deterministic at seed 0. board_from_schematic already includes this step.

ecad_autoroute.prompt_note: Needs a ratsnest — ecad_update_from_sch first. Failed nets are named; give them room or route by hand. ecad_optimize_traces polishes after.

ecad_check_diff_impedance.prompt_note: Both nets must already be routed. To CHANGE geometry toward a target, solve first with ecad_stackup_solve — this only measures.

ecad_check_impedance.prompt_note: Omit net_or_ref to scan all routed nets for controlled-impedance candidates. Same IPC-2141A models ecad_stackup_solve inverts, so solved traces read back on-target.

ecad_design.prompt_note: Front door for a new circuit: plain-English request -> verified schematic + sim, offline via recipes. It becomes the active doc; board_from_schematic is next.

ecad_export.prompt_note: Run ecad_fill_zones first so Gerbers carry the true pour. kind='constraints' emits FPGA XDC/LPF — pair with ecad_fpga_check.

ecad_fill_zones.prompt_note: Required before Gerber export — the post-edit preview fill is coarse and not what ships. Re-run after any copper edit.

ecad_find_part.prompt_note: Always search before placing — never invent a libid/fpid. Feed the exact libid of a hit to ecad_place_symbol.

ecad_fpga_check.prompt_note: Schematic-side (not board) bank/pin checks; pass io= to declare IOSTANDARDs or VCCIO inference is a guess. Export constraints after via ecad_export.

ecad_label.prompt_note: Same text+scope merges nets — the clean wire-free connect across a sheet (scope='global' crosses sheets). Names feed ERC, netlist, and SPICE probes.

ecad_lint_schematic.prompt_note: Geometry self-check BEFORE ecad_run_erc, which only catches electrical faults: symbol-body overlap, dangling wire ends, wires crossing a body, labels attached to nothing. Names the offending refdes/coordinates/label text. Power rails with no drawn body are skipped and listed, not guessed.

ecad_make_board.prompt_note: One-shot sync->route->fill->DRC from the active schematic (pass doc_id when several are open); hostcheck=True folds in the MCU rule pack.

ecad_make_part.prompt_note: Creates a real symbol+footprint from a pinout YOU supply — this is what ecad_find_part routes to when it refuses to substitute a >3-pin part. Requires name + pins (each {number,name,type,side}) + package (chip/soic/qfn/qfp/sot/dip/header/module_castellated) with its pitch/body dims. It will NOT invent a pinout from a part name: no pins means refusal. Pin type must be the exact KiCad enum — 'power'/'vcc'/'gnd' are refused as ambiguous, use power_in or power_out. Then ecad_place_symbol by the returned libid.

ecad_new_pcb.prompt_note: Manual board path: new PCB -> footprints (fpids via ecad_find_part) -> route -> ecad_run_drc. For a schematic-driven board use board_from_schematic instead.

ecad_new_schematic.prompt_note: Becomes the active doc — omit doc_id afterwards. Next moves: ecad_find_part, then ecad_place_symbol with value set.

ecad_optimize_traces.prompt_note: Post-route polish: run after autoroute, before fill/DRC. Pass targets={net: ohms} to retune widths; idempotent and DRC-guarded, safe to re-run.

ecad_place_symbol.prompt_note: libid must come from ecad_find_part. Set value now ('1k', '5') for simulation, and keep the returned pin xy list — ecad_wire needs it.

ecad_route_pad_to_pad.prompt_note: Hand-routes the nets ecad_autoroute reported as failed. Needs from_ref/from_pad/to_ref/to_pad. The net is READ off the pads — pads on different nets are refused, never shorted. Width comes from the ecad_stackup_solve net class unless you pass width. Set to_layer to change layer and it inserts a via. Real tracks, so ecad_run_drc sees them.

ecad_run_dfm.prompt_note: Fab-readiness pass once DRC is clean; fix courtyard_overlap first, then drill_min. Advisory — warnings never block editing.

ecad_run_drc.prompt_note: Advisory spacing/size check after routing — the by_rule grouping says widen, move, or re-space. Pair with ecad_run_dfm before export.

ecad_run_erc.prompt_note: Schematic gate before board sync: errors (output shorts, undriven power) are real bugs; warnings are usually unwired pins. Never blocks edits.

ecad_run_hostcheck.prompt_note: Catches board-bricking MCU/FPGA issues DRC can't (decoupling, sequencing, crystal, straps); needs eng metadata — seed via sim_params.eng.

ecad_run_pdn.prompt_note: DC IR-drop on routed copper. Currents come from rail metadata or sink_overrides — unknown draws are reported, never modelled as 0 A.

ecad_run_sicheck.prompt_note: Fires only from ecad_set_net_class declarations — declare match/skew/termination first or nothing runs. Heuristics, not a field solver.

ecad_set_net_class.prompt_note: THE SI-rule declaration path (params merge additively, same schema ecad_stackup_solve writes); ecad_run_sicheck reads these classes.

ecad_simulate.prompt_note: Start with 'op', then tran/ac; omitting probes returns a bounded ~12-node set. ngspice unlocks vendor models but degrades honestly to mna.

ecad_stackup_solve.prompt_note: Solve BEFORE routing so autoroute/DRC inherit solved widths/gaps via net classes; net_map binds existing nets. Works boardless for design-ahead.

ecad_status.prompt_note: First call when unsure — compact counts plus prioritized next_actions. Drill down with detail='list'/'full' + include='pins,members' only when wiring.

ecad_sweep.prompt_note: One parameter, explicit values list (no start/stop/step); re-runs the analysis per value — keep the list short on transient runs.

ecad_tf.prompt_note: DC gain + Rin + Rout in one shot — the amp gain/loading check. backend='ngspice' only matters for vendor .SUBCKT parts.

ecad_thermal_handoff.prompt_note: Board->thermal FEA in one call; unpowered components get no source (coverage.unpowered_refs). dry_run inspects BCs; ecad_verify_thermal gives the verdict.

ecad_to_3d.prompt_note: Run once the board has an outline; writes STEP plus the boardphys sidecar that thermal/PDN/power_budget consume. Import the STEP for enclosure design.

ecad_update_from_sch.prompt_note: The schematic->board sync: run after ERC-clean wiring, before routing; re-run to re-sync after schematic edits. Sim sources/power symbols skip by design.

ecad_verify_airflow.prompt_note: Follow-up to ecad_airflow_handoff (uses the session's last solves by default); an optimistic preset returns an effective-h to re-run with.

ecad_verify_thermal.prompt_note: Verdict step after ecad_thermal_handoff: Tj vs limits + theta_ja cross-check. The 75% tolerance is deliberate — catches setup blunders, not layout accuracy.

ecad_vibe_check.prompt_note: Screening, not sign-off: default flat PSD is a NAVMAT-class level — pass psd_breakpoints for a spec-true run. dry_run shows mounts/mass model first.

ecad_wire.prompt_note: Pins accept numbers or names from ecad_place_symbol's pin list; confirm the join in the returned net_members. For rails prefer ecad_add_power.

em_driven.prompt_note: Uniform-guide default is analytic-uniform: ideal matched S21 propagation, not evidence for a discontinuity or antenna. Frequencies are GHz, length is mm. Call em_status before solver='openems'; absent openEMS returns ok:false/skipped. detail=True returns full S-parameter arrays.

em_eigenmode.prompt_note: Requires standard='WR-90' or waveguide JSON {shape,a_mm,b_mm,eps_r?}; default solver is builtin-fdfd. Frequencies are GHz in the result. Refine resolution and require TE10 error_vs_analytic_pct to settle before quoting cutoff; detail=True includes field data.

em_status.prompt_note: Capability probe before requesting full-wave work. builtin-fdfd eigenmode and analytic-uniform driven/time-domain are expected built-ins; inspect solvers/defaults. openEMS installed=false means full-wave is unavailable, never a successful fallback.

em_timedomain.prompt_note: Uniform-guide pulse delay/dispersion, not an S-parameter sweep. length is mm and f0_ghz/bw_ghz are GHz; zero values auto-derive a band. Default is analytic dispersive IFFT. Check em_status before openEMS; detail=True returns waveforms.

enable_tools.prompt_note: Enable only the packs the current step needs — every enabled tool costs prompt tokens for the rest of the turn.

engine_profile.prompt_note: Perf triage for THIS engine process: start → work → stop/report; 'contention' is the multi-agent g_mtx bottleneck the CPU sampler can't see.

engine_profile_tree.prompt_note: Scoped profile read — start at depth=1/top=8, drill with path=... instead of ingesting the whole report; source='phases' needs no start.

export_drawing.prompt_note: 2D drawings only (doc_id = the drawing_doc_id) — 3D parts go through export_part; review_drawing first so you don't export a broken sheet.

export_part.prompt_note: Interchange/mesh only — no feature tree or studies survive; to deliver an editable part use save_part (.step+). fmt='step+' routes to the native saver.

export_reveng_bundle.prompt_note: Archival/hand-off only — zips the whole session dir (images, mesh, fits); not part of the in-app flow. dest's parent dir is created.

feeds_speeds.prompt_note: Look up the envelope before pinning params in cam_add_operation; pass machine= to clamp to a real machine's rpm/feed limits.

fit_calc.prompt_note: Call BEFORE any hole/bore sizing decision; if the fit class is unknown, resolve function first with recommend_fit. A bare diameter alone returns a teaching error naming both modes.

fit_report.prompt_note: No args = document report (needs measurements recorded first); explicit bore/shaft args = ad-hoc one-off, same engine as fit_calc.

fs_edit.prompt_note: Copy 'old' verbatim (indentation included) from an fs_read window; an 'ambiguous' error means widen the surrounding context, not retry the same string.

fs_glob.prompt_note: Matches come back newest-first, so recently generated outputs surface at the top; '**' recurses — anchor it under a subdirectory to stay under the 1000-result cap.

fs_grep.prompt_note: Python regex, line-oriented; skips files >8 MiB and stops after 5000 files, so narrow big trees with path+glob; follow hits up with fs_read's line selector.

fs_list.prompt_note: Directories only (a file path errors) — orient here first, then fs_glob/fs_grep to go deeper; dirs sort before files.

fs_read.prompt_note: Windowed by design: after a fs_grep hit, jump straight there with a 'path:50-200' selector instead of paging from the top; binary files are refused, directories list entries.

fs_write.prompt_note: Full overwrite, no append — never use it to patch an existing file; that is fs_edit's job. Parent dirs are created for you.

fw_avr_flash.prompt_note: Flash an AVR target with avrdude — requires hex_path and mcu (programmer='arduino' pairs with the arduino-cli build; leave port empty for USB HID programmers like usbasp). Needs avrdude plus live hardware; without either, fw_emulate_simavr is the honest path.

fw_build.prompt_note: Cross-compile the project to an ELF — requires project_id from fw_new_project; a missing toolchain returns success=false returncode=-1, not an error, so surface the install hint instead of retrying. Then fw_sim_run with the returned elf_path.

fw_debug_gdb_halt.prompt_note: Halt an ARM target through OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg; prefer fw_debug_halt when probe-rs covers the chip. Needs openocd and arm-none-eabi-gdb on PATH plus a live SWD/JTAG probe; then fw_debug_gdb_read_mem or fw_debug_gdb_step.

fw_debug_gdb_read_mem.prompt_note: Read target memory over OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg, address and length, and a halted target (fw_debug_gdb_halt first); output is the raw MI record, NOT decoded hex, so prefer fw_debug_read_mem when probe-rs supports the chip.

fw_debug_gdb_reset.prompt_note: Reset an ARM target via a fresh OpenOCD + gdb/MI session — requires openocd_cfg (halt=True stops at reset). Fallback for chips outside probe-rs's registry; each call re-attaches, so breakpoints do not reliably persist. Needs openocd plus a live probe.

fw_debug_gdb_set_breakpoint.prompt_note: Insert a breakpoint over OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg and address, raw addresses only ('0x8000100') because no symbol table is loaded, so 'main' will not resolve. May not survive the next call's fresh attach; continue with fw_debug_gdb_step.

fw_debug_gdb_step.prompt_note: Single-instruction step an ARM target — requires openocd_cfg and a halted target (fw_debug_gdb_halt or a breakpoint hit first); step_over=True steps over calls. Inspect with fw_debug_gdb_read_mem.

fw_debug_halt.prompt_note: Reset-and-halt a target via probe-rs — requires chip (the probe-rs chip id); needs probe-rs on PATH plus a live DAP probe. Inspect with fw_debug_read_mem, resume with fw_debug_start.

fw_debug_read_mem.prompt_note: Read target memory via probe-rs — requires chip, address and length, and a halted target (fw_debug_halt first); returns decoded data_hex, unlike the gdb variant's raw MI record. Needs probe-rs plus a live probe.

fw_debug_start.prompt_note: Reset and run a target via probe-rs — requires chip; the counterpart that resumes after fw_debug_halt/fw_debug_read_mem inspection. Needs probe-rs plus a live DAP probe.

fw_emulate_renode.prompt_note: Run an EXISTING Renode script — requires resc_path (fw_sim_run generates .resc files; hand-author only for what it cannot cover); the scheduled stop after run_s reports success=True. Needs renode on PATH; for a project-driven run use fw_sim_run instead.

fw_emulate_simavr.prompt_note: Emulate or debug an AVR ELF with simavr — requires elf_path and mcu; gdb=True drives avr-gdb through mi_commands (the universal AVR debug path, since modern UPDI debug has no open GDB exposure). Needs simavr on PATH; real silicon is fw_avr_flash.

fw_flash.prompt_note: Flash a built image to real hardware — requires elf_path (probe-rs for an .elf with chip, esptool for an ESP32 .bin when port is given); missing tools return success=false, not errors. Needs probe-rs or esptool plus a connected board; prove the firmware with fw_sim_run first.

fw_new_project.prompt_note: Scaffold the firmware project once and keep its project_id — pass name and mcu_family (toolchain defaults to 'cmake'), plus board_doc_ref to link a PCB so mcu_family comes from the BOM and a pinmap.h of PIN_<NET> defines is generated; it returns root_dir, which is OUTSIDE the fs jail. Then author code with fw_sources(write={...}), never fs_write.

fw_power_profile.prompt_note: Derive an aicad.powerprofile/1 duty-cycle current profile from an EXISTING trace — requires trace_path (the <elf>.trace.json fw_sim_run returned); no live emulation. Bookkeeping, not SPICE; its per-rail schedules feed power_budget and run_fea_thermal transients.

fw_sensor_scenario.prompt_note: Turn a flight/CFD/kinematic profile into emulated sensor stimulus — pass profile (a JSON object string with t_s plus the physical series) and sensor_map [{device, address}]; pure Python, no Renode needed. Feed the returned scenario to fw_sim_run(scenario=...).

fw_serial_close.prompt_note: Release a live serial handle — requires handle from fw_serial_open; an already-closed or unknown handle returns success=false, not an error. Last step of the fw_serial_* monitor loop.

fw_serial_open.prompt_note: Open a raw 8N1 byte pipe to a PHYSICAL device — requires port (baud defaults to 115200); the returned handle is process-local and dies with the host. Then fw_serial_read / fw_serial_write, and always fw_serial_close. Emulator UART is fw_sim_run instead.

fw_serial_read.prompt_note: Non-blocking poll of a live serial handle — requires handle from fw_serial_open; empty data_hex means nothing buffered, not an error, so poll repeatedly and decode the hex yourself. Close with fw_serial_close.

fw_serial_write.prompt_note: Write to a live serial handle — requires handle plus either data_hex (raw bytes) or text (console typing); data_hex wins when both are given. Read the reply with fw_serial_read.

fw_sim_run.prompt_note: Emulate the built firmware and check assertions — requires project_id (plus elf_path/scenario/assertions; run_s is how long the TARGET runs, a floor not a cap, and a longer scenario timeline still extends it, while timeout_s is the wall-clock budget and wins outright; power_profile=True folds in fw_power_profile) and a successful fw_build first; scenarios and gpio assertions are Renode-only, ESP32 is build+flash. An absent emulator is an honest SKIP in uart_log, never a FAIL to invent around; then fw_power_profile on the returned trace_path.

fw_sources.prompt_note: The ONLY way to get firmware code on disk — requires project_id, and author with write={'src/main.c': '<code>'} (never fs_write: the project root is outside the fs jail and fs_write refuses it). write also appends compilable paths to the CMakeLists add_executable() so fw_build compiles them; bare add=['src/x.c'] only stubs an EMPTY file. Use PIN_<NET> constants from pinmap.h, never raw pin numbers. Then fw_build.

fw_status.prompt_note: Firmware provisioning doctor — needs no arguments (a project_id is accepted and ignored) and never fails, offline-safe; read families.*.can_build/can_emulate/can_flash and the install banners before anything else. Call FIRST, then fw_new_project.

fw_verify_board.prompt_note: Pre-fab firmware<->board co-verification — requires board_doc_ref (pass project_id so pin refs come from the sources, sch_doc_ref for drive-clash checks, trace_path or emulate=True for the dynamic pass). Advisory ERC-shaped findings; run after fw_build/fw_sim_run.

gear_check.prompt_note: SF fields stay null until you pass the allowable stresses — supply S_t/S_c for a pass/fail read; take J/I from AGMA 908 charts.

get_job.prompt_note: Poll the job_id a backgrounded heavy call returned (add_features / run_fea_* / run_cfd_flow) — never re-issue the original call.

get_part.prompt_note: summary=True on big/imported docs (elides BREP blobs); the full tree is for round-trip param editing. Feature ids here feed edits and config overrides.

get_reveng_coverage.prompt_note: Check before reveng_reconstruct: capture the `missing` shot slots first, and always surface `method` — count_proxy is an estimate until a sparse model exists.

get_reveng_deviation.prompt_note: Post-build quality check; ref_path is required (the brep_doc_id lane errors as not-yet-implemented). Bigger n_samples on dense scans.

get_reveng_session.prompt_note: The polling read while a mission runs — session.run mirrors run progress. Find ids with list_reveng_sessions first.

health_check.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health for one body. For the whole-part review battery call design_review; for sketch state, sketch_health.

heatsink_select.prompt_note: Run ecad_thermal_handoff FIRST — this re-solves on its cached mesh, one solve per candidate. Impossible targets name the best achievable, never fake a win.

hover.prompt_note: Feed it a sid from describe_part / query_geometry; hover only the 1-2 entities an edit touches instead of re-reading the whole outline.

hydraulic_add_component.prompt_note: Needs an active circuit (hydraulic_new first). Per-type param keys are in contracts/hydraulic_schema.md; fill sourcing so hydraulic_bom isn't un-sourced.

hydraulic_add_hose.prompt_note: Connects ports by component_id+port from hydraulic_add_component's returned ids; a net takes >=2 connections (pressure/tank/work_a/work_b/drain).

hydraulic_bom.prompt_note: Roll up after components are in; lines without mpn come back flagged un-sourced — the summary lists what still needs sourcing.

hydraulic_fea_handoff.prompt_note: Only builds run_fea_static arg sets — it never solves. Pass fea_args to run_fea_static, then close the chain with hydraulic_verify_fea.

hydraulic_new.prompt_note: First call of the hydraulic workflow — the returned doc becomes the implicit session doc for all later hydraulic_* calls.

hydraulic_piping_handoff.prompt_note: Runs the real piping solve inline and returns the simhandoff envelope — pass load_pressure_bar for the pump margin; verify with hydraulic_verify_piping.

hydraulic_size_cylinder.prompt_note: Pure sizing hand-calc, no document needed; rod_mm=0 makes retract=extend. Feed the recommended flow to hydraulic_size_pump next.

hydraulic_size_pump.prompt_note: Hand-calc counterpart to hydraulic_size_cylinder; displacement scales inversely with speed_rpm, so set the real motor speed.

hydraulic_verify_fea.prompt_note: Verify node for the hydraulic-to-FEA envelope (defaults to the session's last); fea_result is advisory — the force-magnitude checks gate the verdict.

hydraulic_verify_piping.prompt_note: Verify node for the piping coupling; no args reuses the session's last handoff+solve. Pass supply/load pressures to refresh the pump margin.

import_artifact.prompt_note: Second step of the scrape lane — only call with an artifact_path from a done scrape job (scrape_queue_status); afterwards reverse_engineer(source=doc_id) can recover features.

import_part.prompt_note: into=doc_id adds to the current part; omit for a new doc. .sldprt rebuilds the SW tree (needs local SolidWorks); mesh → as_solid=True to sew a solid.

import_scan_mesh.prompt_note: Bypasses photogrammetry when a scan mesh already exists; pass scale_mm if known, else calibrate afterwards with reveng_set_scale.

inspect_feature.prompt_note: One-call post-mutation feature check (render + dims + describe excerpt) — prefer over hand-chaining inspect_part + measure; whole-part → render_part.

inspect_part.prompt_note: Close-up of ONE face/edge/feature via a plain-word target; orbit the same target → look_around, one-call with dims/describe → inspect_feature.

inspect_section.prompt_note: The cut always passes through the ORIGIN on a reserved plane — returns area/centroid/Ixx/Iyy; an offset cut belongs in a drawing (add_section_view).

intake_status.prompt_note: Cheap orient call before any intake work: bound process, open critical-dim demands, and any pending photo request to resume.

interface_check.prompt_note: Catches hole-pattern/coaxiality misalignment that passes check_interference — solve_mates first, run BOTH; fastener='M6' adds a pass-through check.

is_watertight.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health (same tool, trimesh's name). Returns the full report, not a bare bool — read `watertight` plus free_edges/non_manifold_edges for why.

layout_plan.prompt_note: Intake-time, BEFORE add_features — records envelope/critical dims/interfaces as requirements so the layout_coverage gate can check them at sign-off.

layout_plan_report.prompt_note: Read back the plan plus verification coverage (verified vs outstanding); the doc must have a layout_plan recorded first.

ledger_events.prompt_note: Raw event stream for the GUI transparency feed — agents almost always want ledger_get instead.

ledger_get.prompt_note: Section names are fuzzy-matched — pass one bare name (decisions, dimensions, …) or omit for the full render; raise budget_tokens for large ledgers.

ledger_note.prompt_note: The run's append-only memory: record every decision/dimension with provenance so later turns never re-derive a number.

list_artifacts.prompt_note: Newest-first artifact registry (reports/decks/workbooks); filter by run_id — an unknown run_id is count:0, not an error.

list_calcs.prompt_note: Discovery for research_eng_calc: call once to learn the registered calc_ids and their input schemas instead of guessing formula names.

list_configurations.prompt_note: See the variants and which is active before editing; build with add_configuration + set_config_override, switch with activate_configuration.

list_parts.prompt_note: Open docs in this session; after a server restart this is empty — recover_parts reloads the autosaved docs (with fresh doc_ids).

list_reveng_dims.prompt_note: Read before a dimension gate: rows arrive strongest-evidence-first and `key` is what the confirm ledger expects back. Empty list means nothing measured yet.

list_reveng_sessions.prompt_note: Discovery read — find session_ids and statuses before calling any other reveng_* tool.

list_spec_templates.prompt_note: Call before spec_sheet_match: required keys gate the build and are never defaulted, so the datasheet must yield exactly these dims.

list_standard_parts.prompt_note: Catalog browse for make_standard_part (family keys, sizes, lengths) — standard-before-custom: check here before modeling hardware by hand.

list_tool_categories.prompt_note: List the requestable category packs, then unlock with enable_tools(categories=[...]).

list_world_bodies.prompt_note: World-placed bboxes per body/component — read right after solve_mates to confirm where everything landed; pair with check_interference for fit.

look_around.prompt_note: Orbiting close-ups of one feature when a single angle is ambiguous; for dims + describe excerpt in the same call use inspect_feature.

make_drawing.prompt_note: Empty docs are rejected — build geometry first; returns drawing_doc_id + view map, then review_drawing and refine with the add_* drawing tools.

make_fit_coupon.prompt_note: Needs measured dims on the interface first; returns a NEW doc_id to export with export_part for a real test-fit before the full print.

make_presentation.prompt_note: Load-bearing numbers must reference attached_results tool outputs — a bare numeral is a validation error; spec shape in cad_guide('deliverables').

make_report.prompt_note: Same spec envelope as make_presentation; format docx (default) or pdf. Provenance is enforced BEFORE any file is written.

make_standard_part.prompt_note: list_standard_parts first for family/size keys; makes the new doc CURRENT — save_part it before asm_add_component; the returned datum aids placement.

make_workbook.prompt_note: Rows mix prose labels, provenance value cells and live formulas ('=SUM(B2:B5)') that recompute on open; spec in cad_guide('deliverables').

match_model.prompt_note: For branded products (MPN/brand, no standard designation). On no confident repo match, follow fallback.how — usually reverse_engineer_product.

match_part_number.prompt_note: First stop for a purchased MPN — strips vendor suffixes (-ND etc.) and runs fully offline; on matched=false fall through to match_model, never guess params.

measure.prompt_note: Colour-coded multi-element probe returning image + caption; for a pure text distance/angle reading without a render use measure_between.

measure_between.prompt_note: Each query must resolve to exactly ONE face/edge — narrow with pick/side or run query_geometry first; omit b_query for intrinsic area/length/radius.

measure_from_photo.prompt_note: Needs a photo_id from submit_part_photos first; px_a/px_b are FULL-RES pixel coords; low-tier reads still demand confirm_dimensions.

measure_part.prompt_note: Combined mass props over ALL bodies (per-body under mass.bodies[]); pass density_g_cm3 for non-steel; also sanity-checks the solid is closed/valid.

mission_start.prompt_note: Compiles but does not execute — then dag_run(run_id=<its run_id>) starts it (bare dag_run() reuses the same graph). Needs a deliverable manifest; you may write it yourself. Call it without `manifest` and the refusal hands you a fill-in template.

mission_status.prompt_note: Phase-level view (stage_log, open questions) from the run's ledger; use dag_status for raw topology. Fails if the run has no ledger.

motion_fea_handoff.prompt_note: One-call worst-frame stress check on an assembly link (needs mates). dry_run=True shows the loads before you pay for the FEA solve.

new_assembly.prompt_note: Components come from FILES: build parts, save_part each, then new_assembly → asm_add_component → asm_mate → solve_mates.

new_part.prompt_note: Returns the new doc_id and makes it current — follow with add_features. ONE DESIGN IS ONE DOCUMENT: iterate on an existing part IN PLACE, never bump the name (holster_v2, bracket-rev4) — versions live in history (plm_timeline/plm_rollback), and a bumped name is resumed, not minted.

office_edit_csv.prompt_note: Full rewrite — you must send the ENTIRE dataset every call; rows is data rows only, pass header separately. office_read_csv first to preserve what you don't change.

office_edit_doc.prompt_note: Lossy soffice round-trip (.doc→.docx→.doc) with office_edit_docx ops in the middle — legacy .doc features may not survive. Prefer office_edit_docx whenever a .docx exists.

office_edit_docx.prompt_note: paragraph_index is 0-based over body paragraphs only (no table cells); text goes into the first run and the rest are blanked — per-run formatting in the paragraph is lost.

office_edit_pdf.prompt_note: Page indices in ops are 0-based and ops apply sequentially, so deletes shift later pages — delete in descending order. For text changes: extract, edit the docx, re-export to PDF.

office_edit_pptx.prompt_note: slide and shape_index are 0-based and shape_index counts ALL shapes on the slide, not just text frames; one invalid op aborts the whole batch before anything is saved.

office_edit_xlsx.prompt_note: Preserves existing formulas and .xlsm macros, but the openpyxl round-trip drops charts/images, and a newly written formula has no cached value until Excel recalculates it.

office_extract.prompt_note: Cheapest first look at any office file — dispatch by extension. Switch to the per-format office_read_* reader when you need structure (pptx notes, pdf page_range, single xlsx sheet).

office_read_csv.prompt_note: First row is always returned as header, never as data; the effective default returns at most 500 data rows. Pass limit=0 explicitly only when you intend to read every row.

office_read_doc.prompt_note: Needs soffice/libreoffice on PATH (reason:converter_missing otherwise) — headless-converts to .docx in a tmp dir, then reads exactly like office_read_docx.

office_read_docx.prompt_note: Body-level paragraphs + tables only (no headers, footers or text boxes). paragraph order here is exactly what office_edit_docx(paragraph_index) addresses.

office_read_pdf.prompt_note: page_range input is 1-based ("1-3,5") but the returned page.index is 0-based — mind the shift when feeding indices to office_edit_pdf.

office_read_pptx.prompt_note: text_runs skips empty text frames, so run position is NOT the shape_index office_edit_pptx expects — count all shapes on the slide when targeting an edit.

office_read_xlsx.prompt_note: Returns cached values (data_only=True) — a formula cell shows its last calculated value or None if never calculated; the formula text itself is not visible here.

part_get.prompt_note: Fetch the full PartRecord after a part_search hit — summary rows omit the params/specs you need before part_place or cam_tool_import.

part_place.prompt_note: doc is the document dict (or its json.dumps), NEVER a doc id; omit doc for mechanical parts — they create their own document.

part_search.prompt_note: Use when you know the designation or category; for a plain-language need start with part_source instead. Rows are compact — part_get for the full record.

part_source.prompt_note: One call for 'I need X with dims' — each candidate carries an artifact_plan (part_place / scrape_enqueue+import_artifact / make_standard_part); follow it, don't re-search.

parts_taxonomy.prompt_note: Browse here when the user names a category loosely; a node's effective facets are exactly the facet keys part_search(facets=...) accepts there.

piping_cfd_handoff.prompt_note: Solve -> bore STEP -> LBM CFD in one call; use background=True on big grids. RANS accuracy needs a manual run_cfd_accurate + piping_verify_cfd.

piping_fluid.prompt_note: Pre-flight the fluid before piping_solve — same sourced values the solver uses; unknown names return ok:false with a hint, never invented numbers.

piping_internal_volume.prompt_note: Geometry bridge to CFD: import the STEP as a part, then run_cfd_flow. piping_cfd_handoff already does this whole chain.

piping_operating_point.prompt_note: Pump-curve CSV (flow m3/h, head m) as text or path; omit system to derive the system curve from a piping doc + boundary.

piping_report.prompt_note: No-arg call re-reads the most recent piping_solve — cheapest K-factor breakdown; pass doc+boundary only for a fresh network.

piping_solve.prompt_note: At least one fixed pressure/head node is required; node ids come from snapped run endpoints — read them from the result before writing boundary entries.

piping_verify_cfd.prompt_note: Verify node after piping_cfd_handoff (reuses its stored result with no args); compares dP budgets at tolerance_pct, not flow fields.

plm_add_remote.prompt_note: Register before plm_sync/plm_lock. folder/ssh/https work via the url string; chudware-cloud is config-only. Folder remotes take a bare repo path in url.

plm_checkpoint.prompt_note: Always pass a plain-language message — it is how the point is found later. item_id scopes the checkpoint to one item. On reason='locked', call plm_item_set(item_id=<id>, start_new_rev=True), then retry.

plm_compare.prompt_note: Get both commit ids from plm_history first. visual=True rebuilds both versions in the C++ engine and renders PNGs — slow, degrades gracefully without the engine.

plm_graph_brief.prompt_note: One-node dossier (identity, degree, edge kinds, neighbors) — the cheap orientation call before expanding anything in the project graph.

plm_graph_changes.prompt_note: Diffs the project graph against its last cached build — run after edits to see what your change actually touched.

plm_graph_configure.prompt_note: Get/set what the graph builder ingests (office content, linked projects); op='get' first — the build reads this config.

plm_graph_keyword.prompt_note: Tag graph nodes/paths with keywords so plm_graph_search and watch overlays can slice by topic; op='add' by default.

plm_graph_links.prompt_note: List/remove hand- or AI-authored overlay links; the add half is cad_graph_link — pair suggestions (plm_graph_suggest) with explicit links for relationships that matter.

plm_graph_neighbors.prompt_note: Ego graph around node_id within depth hops — widen depth only when depth=1 misses the dependency you are tracing.

plm_graph_search.prompt_note: Substring/kind/keyword search over the project graph — the entry point for finding a node_id before brief/neighbors.

plm_graph_suggest.prompt_note: Heuristic overlay-link suggestions; review before linking — suggestions are candidates, not facts.

plm_graph_watch.prompt_note: Manage the watch overlay (keywords/node ids of interest) so later graph diffs flag what you actually care about.

plm_history.prompt_note: Newest first; pass limit to cap tokens on long projects. Commit ids from here drive plm_compare and plm_restore.

plm_init.prompt_note: Vault-backed plm_* tools take the project root as path; omit it to use CHUDWARE_PROJECT_DIR/CHUDWARE_FS_ROOT through the shared outermost-marker resolver. plm_init is idempotent.

plm_item_add.prompt_note: Only for non-design files (specs, datasheets, sim folders): use plm_item_add(path=<project root>, file_path=<file relative to it>) or folder_path for a folder. .step+/.ecad+ design documents auto-track on save; never add them by hand — call plm_checkpoint.

plm_item_set.prompt_note: The only way to edit a released item again: start_new_rev=True opens a working rev. Calling with neither part_number nor start_new_rev errors out.

plm_link_repo.prompt_note: Links a repo by reference only — nothing is copied in; the version pin lands at release. Use plm_item_add when the sources should be versioned in the vault.

plm_lock.prompt_note: Advisory, team-visible; reason='locked' means someone holds it — do not edit around it. Lock before editing a shared item, plm_unlock after.

plm_open.prompt_note: Identical to plm_init (one delegates to the other) — use either to open-or-create a vault; both are zero-config and idempotent.

plm_plan.prompt_note: list first to learn entity ids, then create/update/delete with data; update and delete need id. Entries version and restore with the project.

plm_release.prompt_note: On reason='preflight_failed' read problems, fix them, or re-call with confirm=true. Released items freeze — to edit again use plm_item_set(start_new_rev=True).

plm_restore.prompt_note: Non-destructive — the restore is itself a new entry and can be undone. Get commit ids from plm_history; item_id scopes the restore to one item.

plm_rollback.prompt_note: Undo for AI-authored docs only; for vault state use plm_restore. Get ids from plm_timeline first; '-1' targets the newest checkpoint. Silent — never asks the user.

plm_rollback_check.prompt_note: Non-destructive preflight for plm_rollback — same target syntax, changes nothing. Returns what a rollback WOULD discard (discarded_messages/turns), whether geometry moves (geometry_rollback), and whether the backing file was modified outside this session (file.externally_modified; null = unknown). Call it before any rollback the user did not explicitly confirm.

plm_save.prompt_note: Snapshot the whole project after an edit batch. Use plm_checkpoint for a named return point, plm_release to ship a revision.

plm_set_ai_mode.prompt_note: Per-project setting persisted in the vault. managed lets the copilot write checkpoints itself; assisted (default) only drafts and suggests.

plm_status.prompt_note: Cheap orientation call before release/sync: items with revision + lifecycle, which are dirty (unsaved), head, ai_mode, remotes, locks.

plm_sync.prompt_note: Needs a remote registered via plm_add_remote first. Same-item collisions are copied under a new name, never merged — check conflicts_copied in the result.

plm_timeline.prompt_note: AI-VC checkpoints for AI-authored documents — NOT the project vault timeline (that is plm_history). Empty doc_id lists every AI-VC chain.

plm_unlock.prompt_note: Releases only a lock you hold — always pair with plm_lock once the edit is saved so teammates are not blocked.

plm_where_used.prompt_note: Run before a release or new rev to see the blast radius; transitive=True walks the whole consumer chain. Unknown item_id returns invalid_item.

power_budget.prompt_note: Bookkeeping, not SPICE: feed board_path from ecad_to_3d's sidecar and power_profile_path from fw_power_profile, else it runs degraded (labelled).

preflight_ops.prompt_note: Dry-run on a shadow clone — never mutates the live doc; a 'fail' verdict is advisory and does NOT block add_features. Cheap insurance before big edits.

project_into_sketch.prompt_note: Appends to an EXISTING sketch (convert_face_to_sketch creates one). 'front'/'top'/'right' mean datum planes, not faces — use a sid or side word for solid faces.

query_adjacency.prompt_note: Reach for it to reason about a shared edge — convex outside-corner vs concave pocket edge — which the flat per-face read-back never carries.

query_geometry.prompt_note: Plain-word phrases work for faces AND edges ('the vertical edges', 'the top face') — confirm a pick resolves before referencing it in a feature; zero or >1 match on a slot needing one → narrow with pick/near/count/index. Fully open-ended explore → describe_part + hover instead.

recommend_fit.prompt_note: Function-to-fit-class step before fit_calc; pass the diameter in the same call to get the computed band and skip the follow-up fit_calc entirely.

recover_parts.prompt_note: After a server restart reloads the LAST dropped session's autosaves with FRESH doc_ids (re-map your handles); all=True reaches the full history. BOUNDED to the newest 8 docs; `skipped` counts what stayed on disk. Raise limit= only if the part you want is not among them, because reopening a big pile leaves nothing able to resolve 'the part'.

redo.prompt_note: Usually denied for agents (undo_denied) — roll the doc back with plm_timeline then plm_rollback instead; if it does run, render_part to confirm the restored state.

regen_diagnose.prompt_note: For a FAILED rebuild — pass the failed doc JSON (+ last-good reference_json for a drift check); record the verdict with regen_resolve. Needs a model provider.

regen_resolve.prompt_note: Second half of regen_diagnose: accept/edit/reject the fix card; 'edit' re-applies your edit_ops_json to the ORIGINAL broken document.

render_ascii.prompt_note: Experimental last resort for no-vision models — prefer describe_part / render_part; only its own p-handle callouts are addressable here, not sids.

render_board_ascii.prompt_note: Board mutations already append a compact auto-readback — read that first; use this uncapped full render as the final review before declaring a board done.

render_document.prompt_note: Previews a saved artifact (pptx/docx/xlsx/pdf/…); office formats need LibreOffice on PATH else converter_missing — the artifact itself is untouched.

render_part.prompt_note: Default self-review after every mutation (labelled iso); highlight= points at a target without reframing, target=/emphasize crops to a feature.

render_schematic_ascii.prompt_note: Keep its grid+index output — that is the cell contract apply_ascii_edits(kind='schematic') resolves edits against.

render_sim_ascii.prompt_note: Topological, not spatial — the read after ecad_simulate (or pass offline JSON); for cell-addressed sheet edits use render_schematic_ascii.

render_sketch.prompt_note: Renders the SOLID context + sketch health caption — there is no isolated flat view; the sketch entities themselves → sketch_preview_text.

render_sketch_ascii.prompt_note: add_features batches already append a compact auto-readback — read that first; pair this with sketch_health for the final verify loop.

render_views.prompt_note: Full 6-ortho+iso grid — catches back/bottom features a single iso hides; lighter 4-tile alternative → contact_sheet.

replan_request.prompt_note: Routing dry-run only — reports required approvers, changes nothing; apply with dag_replan once ruled on.

req_create.prompt_note: doc_id embeds the brief in the .step+, req_path writes a standalone .req.json; then add needs/requirements with req_update.

req_report.prompt_note: markdown (default) is the read-only diff-stable view; format='json' returns the raw aicad.req/1 object for programmatic reads.

req_status.prompt_note: Agents may NOT set user_confirmed or waived — verifier outcomes go to verified/failed with an evidence dict attached.

req_update.prompt_note: add_need first, then add_requirement with need_id + kind + verify_by — the verifier names are what req_verify_by_id will later run.

req_verify_by_id.prompt_note: Runs the requirement's verify_by verifiers and writes status+evidence back; confirm_dimensions/dfm_check/fit_report are skipped (unsupported in v1).

request_part_photos.prompt_note: Only after standard-parts lookup fails to resolve the part; the user's files come back next turn via submit_part_photos.

request_quote.prompt_note: No configured API key (XOMETRY_API_KEY / JLCPCB_KEY) → ok=false without any network call. xometry takes a mechanical doc (auto-exports STEP), jlcpcb the Gerber bundle.

request_raise.prompt_note: Raise a worker request to manager/orchestrator/overseer instead of stalling on missing context, resources, or an escalation.

request_resolve.prompt_note: Managers: every raised request MUST be explicitly resolved (grant|deny|escalate) — silent expiry is impossible.

research_datasheet_fetch.prompt_note: The READ tool when the source is a PDF (local path or URL) — research_fetch_page is for HTML. Degrades to ok:false/no_pdf_tool when pdfminer.six is not installed.

research_eng_calc.prompt_note: Not an arithmetic tool (no add/sum). On an unknown-formula error, pick from the returned `known` catalogue instead of retrying spellings; list_calcs shows the schemas up front.

research_fetch_page.prompt_note: The READ step after research_web_search FINDs a source. Cached per URL, so repeat reads are cheap; set tier by how fast the fact changes (pricing/datasheet/standard).

research_material_lookup.prompt_note: Lookup for a NAMED material, not a selector. For 'which alloy for this job' run research_web_search for candidates first, then this per alloy for the actual numbers.

research_standard_section.prompt_note: Bundled table is small: a handful of AISC W-shapes plus NPS 1-6 pipe (sch 40/80), imperial units. On not_found it lists the covered set — fall back to research_web_search.

research_thread_spec.prompt_note: Use before modeling or calling out any thread — designation in (M8x1.25, 1/4-20 UNC), computed minor diameters and tensile stress area out; never recall these from memory.

research_unit_convert.prompt_note: Only length/angle/count families (to mm/deg/count) — stress units like ksi are out of scope. A unit outside its family is rejected as bad_unit, never silently coerced.

research_web_search.prompt_note: FIND step: returns ranked sources to then READ with research_fetch_page. Without TAVILY_API_KEY the DuckDuckGo fallback is labeled confidence:limited.

resolve_process.prompt_note: Decide once, then bind the choice with set_process. Pass run_id so the clarification is ledgered and a DAG gate never re-asks.

reveng_add_images.prompt_note: Capture step for multi-view stills; pass paths OR dir (neither silently adds 0). Verify with get_reveng_coverage before reconstructing.

reveng_add_video.prompt_note: Alternative to reveng_add_images for an orbit video — extracts blur-culled stills synchronously; drop max_frames on long clips.

reveng_attach_result.prompt_note: Final step: makes the result placeable via part_place under part_ref. Run after reveng_build_parametric (or at least a mesh) exists.

reveng_build_parametric.prompt_note: Run after reveng_fit_primitives (fits feed the hints). Single-photo sessions are refused unless strategy='override_approximate'; score with describe_reveng_result.

reveng_fit_primitives.prompt_note: Needs a mesh first (reveng_reconstruct / reveng_single_photo / import_scan_mesh) and open3d provisioned; persists fits.json for reveng_build_parametric.

reveng_gate_status.prompt_note: Poll a mission by session_id; a non-null `gate` means the run is suspended — answer it with reveng_resolve_gate, never by relaunching.

reveng_ingest_datasheet.prompt_note: Datasheet lane; needs docling provisioned (backend_not_provisioned otherwise). Extracted tables surface as dim candidates in list_reveng_dims.

reveng_make_part_from_library.prompt_note: One-call orchestrator for an un-modeled library part. On model_present=false with pending_dims, confirm the fit-critical dims — re-calling never forces them.

reveng_print_scale_mat.prompt_note: Print before capture when no known dimension exists — the aruco_mat solver in reveng_set_scale defaults to exactly this mat's marker spec.

reveng_reconstruct.prompt_note: Async: returns run_id immediately. Add images first, then poll get_reveng_session / reveng_gate_status — the run PAUSES at the scale-confirm gate.

reveng_research_source.prompt_note: No-photo lane: needs part_number, query, or url (one required); offline returns honest ok:false. reveng_start_session(research=...) does this in one step.

reveng_resolve_gate.prompt_note: decision has no default — pass 'approve' or 'reject' explicitly. Reject stops the run but leaves it resumable from the same checkpoint.

reveng_set_scale.prompt_note: aruco_mat needs a reconstruction + printed mat; two_point needs registered-image pixels; known_dim takes your ratio with a provenance source. All leave confirmed=false.

reveng_single_photo.prompt_note: Preview tier when only one photo exists — uses the first image in images/ and force-tags the session approximate, so build_parametric will refuse without the override.

reveng_start_session.prompt_note: First call of any RE flow; pass research= (MPN/query/URL) to auto-populate the datasheet lane or part_ref to seed photos/datasheet from the parts hub.

reveng_status.prompt_note: Call first — probes backends (COLMAP etc.) before promising a reconstruction; pure and offline-safe, with fix-it banners for what's missing.

reverse_engineer.prompt_note: Long rebuild+verify pipeline. Afterwards read rejected/candidates/unexplained, fix by hand, re-prove with compare_parts; hints come from reveng_fit_primitives.

reverse_engineer_product.prompt_note: The hand-off when match_model misses — needs part_id or url; harvests page media + datasheets and opens the GUI ReverseEng tab for a human-in-the-loop session.

review_drawing.prompt_note: SEE the sheet before refining or exporting — fix overlaps with set_view, add add_dimension/add_gdt, then review again in a loop.

run_cfd_accurate.prompt_note: OpenFOAM external-aero RANS; the tool capability-checks first and returns ok:false, skipped:true when unavailable. Always returns job_id when started; poll get_job. Inputs are velocity m/s, aoa degrees, fluid air|water. Start preset='coarse', then refine; only quote Cd/Cl when converged is true.

run_cfd_flow.prompt_note: Built-in directional LBM: velocity is m/s, aoa degrees, fluid is air|water; freestream +X and lift +Z. Check V² force scaling/dynamic pressure, but absolute Cd is uncalibrated. Require converged=true and min_feature_voxels>=~8, then refine cells; use run_cfd_accurate for absolute coefficients. background=True for cells>=120.

run_fea_buckling.prompt_note: CalculiX fixed-free BOX PROXY, not real CAD stress/buckling. Pass exactly one fixture face and one inward axial force in N on one load face; pressure, shear, and tension are rejected. lambda*applied_load is Pcr; lambda<1 fails. The tool returns ok:false, skipped:true when ccx is unavailable; compare euler_reference_pcr_n.

run_fea_contact.prompt_note: CalculiX TWO-BLOCK PROXY proving contact load transfer, not the document's actual contact pair. pressure_mpa must be finite and >0 MPa. Require base_reaction_n≈applied_load_n; ok:false or skipped:true means no verified contact result. Use run_fea_static for real-part stresses.

run_fea_fatigue.prompt_note: Runs real static FEA then S-N postprocessing. Needs the same mounted faces and non-zero N/MPa loads as run_fea_static plus material ultimate_mpa and endurance_mpa. State load_type/load_ratio, surface, reliability and theory; regime='infinite' means >1e6-cycle runout, not immortal. Refine the static mesh.

run_fea_frequency_response.prompt_note: Base-excited modal superposition. fixtures must represent the mount; excitation_dir is a unit direction, base_accel_g is g, damping zeta is assumed, and material density drives Hz. Response peaks should align with returned modal Hz. PSD breakpoints are g²/Hz; no PSD means random.ok=false and no vibration_spec means verdict=null. Output is acceleration only, not stress/deflection.

run_fea_modal.prompt_note: Material density drives Hz. fixtures=[] is a legitimate free-free solve: expect six near-zero rigid-body modes before elastic modes; otherwise fix it exactly as mounted. Compare the first elastic mode to a justified beam/order anchor and across mesh_fineness presets; properties come from material=, never set_material.

run_fea_static.prompt_note: Real-part linear static FEA. Confirm face queries first. fixtures must react a non-zero load: force vectors/magnitude are N, pressure is MPa; zero loads are refused and there is no gravity/self-weight term. An explicit material dict needs E_mpa, nu, and yield_mpa; named registry materials resolve them. set_material is appearance only. Repeat at a finer mesh and compare governing stress/deflection (<10% change) before PASS.

run_fea_thermal.prompt_note: Steady default is a CalculiX 1-D BOX PROXY: exactly one hot_faces and one cold_faces entry need {face,temperature °C}; temperatures must differ and loads are rejected. Compare mid_plane_T to the linear Fourier anchor; ccx absent returns SKIP. Steady needs conductivity_w_mk/k_w_mk in W/(m·K). transient={t_end_s,dt_s,...} uses the real tet mesh with flux_w_m2 or h_w_m2k/t_amb_c; flux-only heat-up is valid and needs conductivity, density_g_cm3, and cp_j_kgk/specific_heat_j_kgk in J/(kg·K).

run_shell.prompt_note: Use for builds/tests/scripts; prefer fs_read/fs_grep/fs_glob/fs_write for plain file work. Stateless per call — pass cwd each time; pipe noisy output through head; check exit_code/timed_out.

save_part.prompt_note: PREFER for delivery — the only format keeping the editable tree + studies; save before close_part/session end (AI docs get no unsaved warning).

scrape_enqueue.prompt_note: Returns immediately — the download runs in the background; poll scrape_queue_status, then import_artifact on done. Site must be logged in (vendor_login) first.

scrape_queue_status.prompt_note: The only way to follow a scrape job — poll this instead of re-enqueueing; artifact_path (input to import_artifact) exists only on status=done.

serving_evaluate.prompt_note: Evidence only — promotes nothing. Pass report_out to write the sign-off artifact serving_promote then needs as report_ref.

serving_promote.prompt_note: No auto-promote path: report_ref must exist and evidence must recompute eligible or promotion_refused; confirm approver first.

serving_rollback.prompt_note: Always-safe routing flip after a bad promote or canary regression; omit to_version to restore the previous adapter from history.

serving_set_canary.prompt_note: Middle rung between evaluate and promote; opt_in replaces (not extends) the early-adopter list — pass the full list.

serving_status.prompt_note: Read-only routing snapshot — call first for exact insertion_point names and versions before canary/promote/rollback.

set_config_override.prompt_note: Edits one param in ONE config (base untouched); vector params take a list (transform translate:[x,y,z]); clear=True removes the override.

set_config_suppression.prompt_note: Per-variant feature on/off without forking the tree; activate_configuration + render_part to confirm the variant looks right.

set_material.prompt_note: VISUAL appearance only — set_material(material='steel' | {'color':[r,g,b],'metallic':...,'roughness':...}, body='b1'|None, doc_id=None) sets render colour/finish and NOTHING else. There is no ops=[...] form. Simulation density/stiffness goes to run_fea_static / run_fea_modal's material= instead (a registry name or an E_mpa/nu dict); run_cfd_flow takes fluid='air'|'water' and has no material argument.

set_process.prompt_note: Call once the process is known (FDM default) — its clearance/wall/thread numbers drive later fit-budgeted dims and dfm_check.

set_titleblock.prompt_note: fields: title/drawn_by/date/material/finish/scale/rev/sheet/part_number/company; verify the filled block with review_drawing.

set_view.prompt_note: Fix overlapping views reported by review_drawing — x,y are sheet mm; scale 1.0 = 1:1, 0.5 = 1:2, 2.0 = 2:1.

show_in_app.prompt_note: Force-push the doc to the open desktop viewport; modeling tools already do this per change — a silent no-op when the app isn't running.

sim_cancel.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run. Really terminates the solver process, not a flag flip; sim_status then reports cancelled. The last partial snapshot survives, so sim_results(partial=True) may still have something.

sim_jobs.prompt_note: Lists recent background solves with their state — use it to recover a job_id from an earlier turn before assuming a solve was lost.

sim_results.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run, after sim_status says done. partial=True returns whatever converged so far, clearly labelled — never quote a partial as a converged answer. partial=False on an unfinished job is refused rather than returning half a result.

sim_run.prompt_note: Cancellable process job for analysis='fea_static' or 'fea_modal' ONLY. Static needs fixtures plus a non-zero loads list; modal takes the fixtures argument but fixtures=[] intentionally requests free-free modes and takes no loads. Poll sim_status, then sim_results; an unavailable/failed backend never becomes PASS.

sim_status.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run. Reports queued/running/done/failed/cancelled and is reconciled against the OS — it never says running for a dead worker. Poll this before sim_results; call sim_jobs() if you lost the id.

simulate_motion.prompt_note: Kinematic sweep of one dimensional mate. stop is required; angle ranges are degrees, distance ranges mm, steps>=2. fixtures/loads do not apply. check_interference samples each step, so refine steps near first contact. dynamics={} adds inverse-dynamics reactions but not contact dynamics.

sketch3d_add_constraints.prompt_note: Point handles are 'e3.p1'/'e3.p2'/'e3.pm'; tangent/symmetric/equal/midpoint are NOT in v1 (validator rejects). Re-check with check_sketch3d.

sketch3d_add_curves.prompt_note: Arcs are THREE-POINT [start,mid,end]; endpoints within 1e-4 mm chain into wires automatically. Simple routes → sketch3d_path_from_points instead.

sketch3d_as_sweep_guide.prompt_note: Returns the ready-to-paste sweep ref (path vs guides[] entry); a guide must be a DIFFERENT feature than the path, one guide per sweep.

sketch3d_clear.prompt_note: Wipes entities but keeps the feature id, so downstream sweep refs survive (they fail until the sketch has a wire again).

sketch3d_from_ledger.prompt_note: DEPRECATED migration shim for old session payloads — new work never needs this; sketch3d features persist with the document.

sketch3d_get.prompt_note: Reads authored constraints + SOLVED entity coordinates (what the GUI shows) + health; use before referencing a wire in a sweep.

sketch3d_list.prompt_note: All sketch3d features with wire/status/length summary — persistent doc features that save with the part, no session store.

sketch3d_new.prompt_note: Needs a current part (new_part first); returns the feature id every other sketch3d_* tool takes — populate via sketch3d_add_curves.

sketch3d_path_from_points.prompt_note: One-call route through world points: polyline = crisp bends, spline = smooth; close=True for a closed sweep path. Then sketch3d_pipe.

sketch3d_pipe.prompt_note: 'Run a 12 mm tube along this path' in one call — pass diameter_mm XOR profile_sketch; a zero-volume error names the pierce gap to fix.

sketch3d_preview.prompt_note: Text-only 'see the path' (solved coords, wire refs, health) — the headless check before sweeping; 2D sketches → sketch_preview_text.

sketch3d_ref_vertex.prompt_note: Mints a model-vertex point handle ('x1') usable in sketch3d_add_constraints refs; it tracks the vertex across rebuilds and warns if it goes stale.

sketch3d_sample_at.prompt_note: Point + tangent at arc-length fraction t∈[0,1] of the SOLVED path — for placing profile planes or datums along a route.

sketch3d_section_at.prompt_note: ENGINE LIMIT: the cut is always at the world ORIGIN — t only picks the plane orientation from the tangent; the on-path point → sketch3d_sample_at.

sketch3d_to_ledger.prompt_note: DEPRECATED — sketch3d features save with the document; this only reports them so old workflows don't dead-end.

sketch_auto_constrain.prompt_note: Auto-runs after sketch edits (sketch.auto_coincident, default ON) — call explicitly only to preview (apply=False) or re-stitch with a looser tol_mm.

sketch_health.prompt_note: Verify step after every sketch edit: apply the schedule in order (relations first, then driving dimensions) and re-run until status is 'full'.

sketch_preview_text.prompt_note: No-vision full text of a 2D sketch (entities/constraints/regions/DOF) — the readable alternative to render_sketch; 3D → sketch3d_preview.

solve_mates.prompt_note: Assembly docs only ('not an assembly' on a part); asm_mate already solves by default — call after bulk edits, then list_world_bodies.

spec_sheet_match.prompt_note: Long-tail lane after match_part_number/match_model fail; run list_spec_templates first — a missing required dim returns matched=false and builds nothing. LLM call, slow.

stackup_analyze.prompt_note: tol is the ± HALF-tolerance and direction ±1 the chain sign; invented tolerances MUST set assumed=True so they surface in assumed_dims.

stage_set.prompt_note: Only when the inferred stage is actually wrong; needs an existing run ledger (run_id) and a replay-visible real reason.

start_capture_session.prompt_note: One session per port — a duplicate call fails and returns the live upload_url. scale_marker_mm is only recorded; real scale comes via reveng_set_scale.

stop_capture_session.prompt_note: Needs MESHROOM_BIN or COLMAP_BIN set; takes minutes. Mesh is in reconstruction units, not mm — reveng_set_scale first, then reverse_engineer(source=mesh_path).

struct_analyze.prompt_note: struct_check already runs this same analysis plus D/C ratios — use struct_analyze only when you want raw member forces, no pass/fail.

struct_check.prompt_note: The go/no-go member check (AISC LRFD steel / NDS ASD wood); dc_ratio<=1 passes. Input is an aicad.structure/1 JSON file on disk.

struct_estimate.prompt_note: Rate-table budget figures, not vendor prices (those are bom_price — don't mix). Same structure doc as struct_check.

submit_bug_report.prompt_note: Only for OUR bugs (a schema-conformant call still fails, a crash, an unknown method) — never for ordinary retry-and-fix errors.

submit_part_photos.prompt_note: photos= registers files (then measure_from_photo); claims= submits dims you read. Close returned open_demands via confirm_dimensions.

suggest_dimension_scheme.prompt_note: Dimension plan for an existing sketch; size mating bores with fit_calc FIRST (they come back needs_user_confirm). process drives the IT grade.

tap_drill.prompt_note: Quick drill size for a thread string; feeds_speeds(thread=...) returns the same value alongside cutting data.

task_list.prompt_note: Publish the FULL list every call (omitted items disappear from the panel) — same order, updated statuses, after each step.

undo.prompt_note: Usually denied for agents (undo_denied) — roll the doc back with plm_timeline then plm_rollback instead; if it does run, render_part to confirm the rolled-back state.

vendor_login.prompt_note: HEADED browser that blocks up to 300s while the HUMAN logs in — tell the user before calling and never retry-loop it; check vendor_status afterwards.

vendor_part_register.prompt_note: Registers a completed scrape's price/availability so bom_price can resolve that supplier + part number — import_artifact handles the geometry, this handles the money. The price is a SCRAPED figure stamped with provenance and a fetch timestamp, never a vendor quote; an ambiguous display price (a range, 'per pack of N') leaves unit_price null and returns price_unparsed rather than guessing — pass unit_price= explicitly to resolve it.

vendor_status.prompt_note: Fast local read (no network) of adapter keys + login state — check this before scrape_enqueue to pick an already-logged-in site.

vendors_health.prompt_note: Live network canary per adapter (blank sweeps all registered sites) — slow; prefer vendor_status for a quick answer. needs_human_login → run vendor_login(site).

verify_battery.prompt_note: The done-gate before declaring a design finished — omitted checks = all subsecond ones; check_metadata lists names/costs. Narrated verdict → design_review.

wall_thickness.prompt_note: Headline is min_thickness_mm vs your process floor (~1 mm injection, ~0.8 mm FDM); null means an open/sheet body — confirm a solid with measure_part.

workspace_doc_events.prompt_note: Incremental per-doc event stream — pass the count of events you already have as since_seq.

workspace_status.prompt_note: One-call orient snapshot: open docs, owners, node statuses. Poll this before touching docs you did not create.
